findings.title: Whole-shift applications disappear from Interested after reload
findings.scenario: Sara applies to Tom's dated shift that requires one person for the entire booking. After reloading, her application remains recorded, but opening Interested hides the shift because the board checks individual-date applications and ignores her whole-shift application.
findings.test_needed: Load a dated single-user shift with its ID in initialAppliedShiftIds and no applied slot IDs; assert Interested displays it.

owner_question.question: When Sara applies for Tom's entire dated booking, should it remain visible in Interested after she reloads?
options: Show Sara's whole booking in Interested
Show whole-booking applications in a separate accessible list
Hide whole-booking applications from Interested (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Interested and rejected tabs cannot reach results on other pages
findings.scenario: Sara previously applied for a shift that now falls on the second page of available opportunities. She returns on the first page and opens Interested, which filters only that loaded page and removes the page controls. Her application is missing from the tab, and she cannot reach it there; the community Rejected tab has the same limitation.
findings.test_needed: Provide more than one server page with Sara's applied shift only on page two; assert Interested can retrieve and display it.

owner_question.question: When Sara opens Interested or Rejected, how should she reach matching shifts outside the currently loaded browse page?
options: Fetch and paginate all matching shifts for Sara
Load all available pages before filtering those tabs
Show only the current browse page without navigation (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Published availability beyond four weeks cannot be requested
findings.scenario: Sara publishes availability six weeks ahead. Tom can see the future dates on her talent card, but Request Booking opens a calendar containing only four weeks with no navigation. None of Sara's dates can be selected, so Tom cannot start a booking request from her post.
findings.test_needed: Give Sara availability six weeks ahead; assert Tom can select that published date and initiate its booking request.

owner_question.question: When Sara publishes a date six weeks ahead, should Tom be able to request it immediately?
options: Let Tom navigate to every published date
Restrict Sara's publishing to the bookable calendar window
Make Tom wait until the date enters the calendar window (keep today's behaviour)

findings.title: Pitch submission errors are hidden on the final tab
findings.scenario: Sara selects willingness to travel but leaves travel states empty, then reaches the final tab and presses Post Availability. Saving is refused, but the explanation appears only on the first tab while Sara remains on the final tab. The same placement hides other save failures, leaving her without a visible explanation.
findings.test_needed: Submit from Time Availability with willingness to travel enabled and no travel state; assert the refusal explanation is visible immediately.

owner_question.question: When Sara's pitch cannot be saved from the final tab, where should she see the reason?
options: Show the error on the current tab
Move Sara to the relevant tab and show the error
Leave the explanation hidden on Basic Info (keep today's behaviour)
